description: This file provides drag-and-drop functionality for tables in Drupal's admin UI, including row manipulation, indentation, column toggling, and event handling for table row reordering.

classes.name: Drupal.tableDrag
classes.description: Class managing drag-and-drop table row operations, including initialization, event handling, and visual updates.

classes.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row
classes.description: Represents a draggable table row, managing indentation, swapping, and change tracking.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag
methods.description: Constructor for the tableDrag object, initializing settings, event handlers, and draggable rows.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.initColumns
methods.description: Initializes columns with form elements to be hidden or shown based on user preferences.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.displayColumns
methods.description: Shows or hides weight/parent columns and triggers a 'columnschange' event.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.toggleColumns
methods.description: Toggles visibility of weight columns and updates local storage.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.hideColumns
methods.description: Hides weight/parent columns and adjusts colspan.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.showColumns
methods.description: Shows weight/parent columns and restores colspan.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.findDropTargetRow
methods.description: Finds the table row over which the dragged row is hovering for potential swap.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.updateFields
methods.description: Updates form fields after a row is dropped.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.updateField
methods.description: Updates a specific form field based on row relationships and actions.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.copyDragClasses
methods.description: Copies CSS classes related to drag-and-drop from one row to another.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.checkScroll
methods.description: Calculates suggested scroll speed when dragging near viewport edges.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.setScroll
methods.description: Scrolls the window during drag if near viewport edges.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.restripeTable
methods.description: Reapplies row striping after reordering.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.dragStart
methods.description: Initializes dragging state and creates a drag object.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.dragRow
methods.description: Handles movement during dragging, including row swapping and indentation.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.dropRow
methods.description: Finalizes row position after drop, updates fields, and cleans up.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.pointerCoords
methods.description: Gets cursor coordinates from event.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.getPointerOffset
methods.description: Calculates offset of cursor from target element.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.findDropTargetRow
methods.description: Identifies the row over which the dragged row is hovering.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row
methods.description: Constructor for a draggable row, managing indentation, children, and change state.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.addChangedWarning
methods.description: Adds a warning message if the row has unsaved changes.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.findChildren
methods.description: Finds child rows based on indentation levels.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.isValidSwap
methods.description: Checks if swapping with another row is valid based on indentation rules.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.swap
methods.description: Swaps the current row with another row.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.validIndentInterval
methods.description: Calculates valid indentation range for a row.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.indent
methods.description: Adjusts indentation level within valid bounds.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.findSiblings
methods.description: Finds sibling rows based on indentation and subgroup.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.removeIndentClasses
methods.description: Removes indentation-related CSS classes from the row.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.markChanged
methods.description: Marks the row as changed and adds visual indicator.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.onIndent
methods.description: Stub for custom behavior on indentation.

methods.name: Drupal.tableDrag.prototype.row.prototype.onSwap
methods.description: Stub for custom behavior on row swap.
